cover_letter.greeting: Dear BlackRock Liquidity & Financing IDA Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Innovation & Data Analytics Associate role in Liquidity & Financing. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The team's focus on AI adoption, citizen development and centralized reporting across Liquidity & Financing is the kind of work I want: business data turned into tools people on a desk actually use.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%. I also worked on AI-powered analytical dashboards, where I owned the mapping and QA, and they saved the team 4+ hours a week on reporting. At Thomson Reuters I managed cash flow analysis covering 80%+ of inflows and helped streamline the order-to-cash process, which cut the cash conversion cycle by 20%.

That maps to the BI and derived-data side of the role. I haven't worked on a lending or financing desk, and my strength is analysis and business requirements more than data engineering, so I'd be honest that the platform side would be a stretch I'd grow into. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the team.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for the Innovation & Data Analytics Associate role in BlackRock's Liquidity & Financing group. At Lenovo I owned mapping and QA on AI-powered dashboards that saved 4+ hours a week, and built forecasts that improved capital efficiency by 15%. I'd love to hear how IDA is using AI across the desks. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
